title: Hazy Memories
subtitle: ... Lifted up, by the hand of your former self.

items.text: Day 1
Practice Room

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: What's this, Ms. Raven?

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: A seed that will settle in your heart and soon grow to be your closest friend. Its roots will stretch all the way from Australia to the soles of your feet, and together, you will make the music to your Floor Ritual.

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: Now, my dear, listen closely. Listen to what it has to say. Listen!

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: Hold it. Feel it. Let it know who you are.

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: It isn't just a piece of wood, but a mouthpiece passed down through the ages.

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: It allows us to understand what our god hears during the ritual!

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: It doesn't look all that special to me.

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: Haha, silly girl. If you want it to speak, you must greet it with your arcane skill first. It's the only language it'll understand!

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: Alright.

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: It's responding!

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: Ugh, that sounds awful.

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: That's because you greeted it awfully.

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: I greeted it awfully? You mean the fluctuation of my arcane skill wasn't stable enough?

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: Yes. Speak to it politely, and it'll respond with politeness.
Day 7

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: *weep* Ms. Raven, that hurts.

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: The path of pilgrimage is full of thorns. It offers no shortcuts. You must make your way, inch by inch.

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: Otherwise, you'll never reach the sanctuary of glory—the place where all the lights gather.

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: And you'll die a nobody.

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: Full of thorns. So, will I be freed from pain if I keep training?

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: Shush. Press your head against your shin, just as the divine son did.

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: Okay. Ugh!

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: Closer! I want that head tight against your shin!

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: Ugh!!

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: The tighter, the better!

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: Yes, Miss ... Ah!
Day 93

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: Confusion, sadness, I can see it all over you.

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: My classmates were making fun of me. They said I was using the training to avoid my duties.

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: They said I never do anything with them. I've skipped classes, sports days, and the summer outing.

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: They said that all I do is train to be a clown in a show.

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: M-Ms. Raven, can I take a break, just for today? I want to spend time with my classmates.

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: No, no. You made a promise, remember?

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: Yes. I promised to focus on my training and never slack, no matter what. If I want to be a champion, I need to be able to beat every other Floor Ritualist in the world.

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: Every tear, every drop of sweat, will pave my path to the podium.

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: So, you do remember it, every word.

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: Our god can only hear the most faithful prayers. Yes, only the most faithful. You must offer everything you have to him. Your heart, your flesh, from here to here.
She traces a path from Charlotte's head to her toes with her finger.

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: If you can't do that, you'll be surpassed and never win the attention of our god.

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: If that happens, you'll be completely forgotten, like you never existed. Is that what you want?

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: No.

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: Then what are you waiting for? Begin.
Day 569

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: Tsk, tsk. No, not like that.

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: Why? This element will score me points!

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: Yes, but not enough!

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: Not enough? Then, they should revise their scoring system!

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: By "not enough," I mean it's imperfect, unfaithful! Our god won't hear you. Are you unwilling to try a better element or simply unable to?

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: Oh, please! I can do any element without even trying!

items.speaker: Coach Raven
items.text: Then show it to our god!

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: I've got it! Stop nagging me!

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: Heh, I suppose I got carried away. This applause isn't for me.

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: But it should be.
Willow rubs her brow, a heavy expression on her face as she peers at Caroline. She's being showered with applause.

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: What distracted me? It must've been that graceful element that Caroline finished perfectly. She had it down to the smallest detail.

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: In that way, we're alike. Sticklers for detail. That's why ...
She squints as her eyes continue to follow Caroline.

items.speaker: Caroline Bartley
items.text: Thank you! Thank you, everyone!

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: I'm feeling so restless.
With a respectful salute, Caroline exits the floor.

items.speaker: Broadcast
items.text: Player No. 2407, Anna Smith, please enter the field.
The ritualist named Anna makes her way to the floor and gets into position.

items.speaker: Caroline Bartley
items.text: What did you think, Charlotte?
Caroline pats Willow's shoulder from behind.

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: Well, you certainly haven't skimped on your training these past years.

items.speaker: Caroline Bartley
items.text: That's it?
Willow shoots Caroline a sharp look.

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: You're better than when you were nine. I'll give you that.

items.speaker: Caroline Bartley
items.text: Haha!

items.speaker: Caroline Bartley
items.text: But ...
Caroline steps toward the railing of the spectator area.

items.speaker: Caroline Bartley
items.text: Are you sure you saw my performance clearly? The smog's rather heavy.
Side by side, Willow and Caroline peer through the dense smog as they watch Anna perform her routine.
Meanwhile, on the opposite side.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Flutterpage.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Ms. Tooth Fairy, Mr. Brimley! Good timin'!

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: Just in time, eh? Well, we wouldn't want to miss Ms. Willow's performance, now, would we?

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: The lady doin' her routine right now is called Anna. It should be Ms. Willow next, but I can hardly see a thing.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: True. The smog's too heavy.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Hopefully, it'll clear before Ms. Willow comes out.
Suddenly, the didgeriwood's song comes to a grinding halt.

items.speaker: Brimley
items.text: What's wrong?
Anna stops mid-routine and gestures toward the judges. Her mouth is moving.
An unease spreads among the crowd.

items.speaker: Spectator I
items.text: Why'd she stop?

items.speaker: Spectator II
items.text: I think she's requesting a timeout.

items.speaker: Spectator III
items.text: A time-out? Is she hurt?
As Anna walks away from the floor, the crowd buzzes with speculation.
After some time, the speakers crackle to life with an announcement.

items.speaker: Broadcast
items.text: *buzz* Silence, please. An announcement from the Floor Ritual judges.

items.speaker: Broadcast
items.text: Due to ... *buzz* ... force majeure ... *buzz* ...

items.speaker: Broadcast
items.text: Player No. 2407, Anna Smith ... requested suspension ... *buzz* ... After discussion ... the judges have decided to ... suspend the game.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Suspended? What about Ms. Willow?! Will she not get to compete?
A number of spectators start to leave, while others stay put.

items.speaker: Spectator I
items.text: Suspended?! We gave everything to hold these Games! How could she just back out like this?!

items.speaker: Spectator III
items.text: I heard that a Winged Key Archery player got injured. Maybe that's why.

items.speaker: Spectator II
items.text: What, so we're supposed to just leave? The Games have hardly begun!

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Ms. Tooth Fairy, what should we do? Ms. Willow was next. It'll be such a shame if she can't play.
Tooth Fairy looks into the murky yellow smog and sighs.
